author: Herbert, Th.
title: Travels, p. 27 (Mohéli/Comorian words)
notes: Not among Glottolog's 5 Mwali refs. ELP Comorian entry cites it via Johnston 1919/Doke 1960; ~10 words, first printed in the 1677 ed. (recorded 1626). Very early Comorian, thin.

author: Balfour, Edw.
title: On the migratory tribes of natives in Central India, J. Asiat. Soc. Bengal XIII (1844) 17-18; also Jameson's Edinburgh Journal no. 69 (1843)
notes: Bauria has only 2 Glottolog refs; Balfour not among them. Same article has Bhatoo (Dommur/Kolhati), Gohur (Lambadi) and Coles words. No web check done.

author: anon.
title: Asiatic Journal VII, 65, 90 (words); Mithridates IV.67
notes: Korwa? (hill people between Berar and Orissa). Identification uncertain. Not in Glottolog Korwa refs (31).

author: Leech, R.
title: A vocabulary of the Baraky language, J. Asiat. Soc. Bengal 1838, 727-731
notes: Ormuri; not in Glottolog's 28 refs but Leech is standard in Iranian literature (cited by Grierson LSI) - not verified on web in this pass.

author: Kielmaier
title: Galla words in Das Ausland 1840, no. 76
notes: Periodical item; not in Glottolog Oromo refs. Not web-checked.

author: Proyart, abbé
title: Histoire de Loango, Kakongo... Paris 1776, ch. XIX (German tr. 1777)
notes: Vili has 68 Glottolog refs, none Proyart; Proyart's language chapter is well known to Kongo historians.

author: Marolla, G.
title: Relazione del viaggio nel Congo, Napoli 1726, pp. 311-316
notes: Kikongo words in a Capuchin travel account; Merolla not among Glottolog refs for South-Central Koongo.

author: Brumund, J.F.G.
title: Proeve over de Aroe-taal, Tijdschrift voor Neêrland's Indië (c.1845)
notes: Aru Is. (Wokam, Wammar) - likely Ujir/Kola/Dobel; Ujir 7 refs, Kola 9, Brumund in neither. Language identity needs checking.

author: Kilham, Hannah
title: Specimens of African languages (Sierra Leone 1828); repr. Outline of a vocabulary..., London 1841, 190-200
notes: Two West African lists Jülg calls otherwise unknown; unidentified. Kilham generally known (Koelle era).

author: Oldendorp, C.G.A.
title: Geschichte der Mission ... I.346 (Danish West Indies slave informants)
notes: Oldendorp's lists are known (Kelly/ Stein editions); several ethnonyms unidentified.
